headline: Chulpan Khamatova Stars in the Dark, Absurdist Play “Delirium”
context: After opposing the war in Ukraine and settling in Latvia, Chulpan Khamatova now comes to New York to star in a dark comedy by Ionesco.

sources.name: The New York Times
